name: participantId
label: Recipient User ID
help: Numeric X user ID of the DM recipient. Use Get User to resolve a username first.

name: text
label: Message
help: Direct message text. Automated DMs require recipient consent per X Automation Rules.

name: idempotencyKey
label: Idempotency Key
help: Leave empty to treat an identical retry as the same operation. Set a new value to repeat an identical operation on purpose.
